2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');

7:   // Audio setup
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     osc.start();
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
21:   }
22:   function playThrust() { playTone(400, 100); }
23:   function playSpawn() { playTone(200, 80); }
24:   function playExplosion() { playTone(100, 500); }
25:   // Simple background hum
26:   setInterval(() => { playTone(60, 2000); }, 5000);
27:   const stars = [];
28:   for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
29:     stars.push({
30:       x: Math.random() * width,
31:       y: Math.random() * height,
32:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
33:     });
34:   }
35:   const stars = [];

37:     stars.push({
38:       x: Math.random() * width,

47:   const center = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2 };
48:   const orbitRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.25;
49:   const shipSize = 12;
50:   const asteroidRadius = 15;
51:   const shipTurnSpeed = 0.003; // rad per ms
52:   const asteroidSpeed = 0.09; // pixels per ms
53:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
54: 
55:   let angle = 0; // ship angle around planet
56:   let fuel = 100; // starts full
57:   let score = 0;
58:   let lastTime = performance.now();
59:   let lastSpawn = 0;
60:   let asteroids = [];

63:   // Input handling

69:   });
70:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
71: 
72:   function spawnAsteroid() {
73:     // random size and rotation speed
74:     const size = asteroidRadius * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.7);
75:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.001; // rad per ms
76:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
77:     const distance = Math.max(width, height) / 2 + size;
78:     asteroids.push({ angle: a, dist: distance, size, rot: 0, rotSpeed });
79:     playSpawn();

82:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.001; // rad per ms

84:     const distance = Math.max(width, height) / 2 + size;

86:   }
87:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
88:     const distance = Math.max(width, height) / 2 + asteroidRadius;
89:     asteroids.push({ angle: a, dist: distance });
90:   }
91: 
92:   function update(dt) {
93:     // rotate asteroids
94:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
95:       a.rot += a.rotSpeed * dt;
96:     });
97:     // ship rotation
98:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) angle -= shipTurnSpeed * dt;
99:     if (keys.ArrowRight) angle += shipTurnSpeed * dt;

101:     angle = (angle + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2);

103:     // fuel consumption
104:     fuel -= dt * 0.02; // depletes over ~5000ms to zero

107:     // spawn asteroids

127:       const dy = ay - shipY;

152:     ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2b2b';
153:     ctx.beginPath();
154:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, orbitRadius * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
155:     ctx.fill();
156:     // ship (triangle)
157:     const shipX = center.x + Math.cos(angle) * orbitRadius;
158:     const shipY = center.y + Math.sin(angle) * orbitRadius;
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
160:     ctx.save();
161:     ctx.translate(shipX, shipY);
162:     ctx.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
163:     ctx.beginPath();
164:     ctx.moveTo(0, -shipSize);
165:     ctx.lineTo(shipSize / 2, shipSize / 2);
166:     ctx.lineTo(-shipSize / 2, shipSize / 2);
167:     ctx.closePath();
168:     ctx.fill();
169:     ctx.restore();
170:     // asteroids (rotating rocks)
171:     for (const a of asteroids) {
172:       const ax = center.x + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.dist;
173:       const ay = center.y + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.dist;

175:       ctx.translate(ax, ay);
176:       ctx.rotate(a.rot);

178:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.size * 0.2, 0, 0, a.size);
179:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff9999');
180:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0000');
181:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
182:       ctx.beginPath();
183:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
184:       ctx.fill();
185:       ctx.restore();

187:     // HUD
188:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
189:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';

191:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 40);
192:     if (!running) {
193:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
194:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
195:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
196:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
197:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
198:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
199:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';

201:     }
202:   }

204:   function loop() {
205:     const now = performance.now();
206:     const dt = now - lastTime;
207:     lastTime = now;
208:     if (running) update(dt);
